title: The scout sandbox grant .evolve/evals/cycle-* widens to every cycle's evals
summary: Found in the review of the sandbox-cross-cycle-run-dir-write fix (2026-10-20). The run-dir glob .evolve/runs/cycle-* now resolves to the dispatch workspace. The scout profile also declares .evolve/evals/cycle-*, and resolveSandboxWriteGrants still widens that glob to its glob-free ancestor .evolve/evals (go/internal/bridge/sandbox_paths.go). So a scout agent can write the evals of any other cycle.
fix: Bind the evals glob to the running cycle (the resolver can take the cycle number from the workspace name, or the profile can name the own cycle through a template), or drop the grant if the scout writes evals only in its run dir. Add a row to the sandbox contract test.
acceptance: A scout agent of cycle N cannot write in .evolve/evals/cycle-M
The scout still writes the evals of its own cycle
docs/architecture/agent-sandbox-contract.md no longer lists this as a known gap
source: console builder R, go-reviewer finding on the sandbox-cross-cycle-run-dir-write fix
